description: This file contains utility functions for managing image caches and request cancellations using Coil in an Android application. It includes methods to clear image caches and cancel in-flight image requests tied to ImageViews, primarily for testing or debugging purposes.

classes.name: ImageCacheUtils
classes.description: A utility singleton object providing methods to clear image caches and cancel ongoing image requests.

methods.name: clearAllCoilCaches
methods.description: Suspended function that clears Coil's memory and disk caches using the provided Android context.

methods.name: cancelOngoingRequest
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing Coil image request associated with the provided ImageView by calling its dispose() method.
